resolved_intents.intent: Get tell your experience text value

missing_methods.intent: Assert tell your experience text is truncated
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: This method should retrieve the current text from the feedback text field using get_entered_text() and verify that the text length does not exceed the expected maximum character limit. It should also verify the character count display matches the actual text length. The method should raise an assertion error if the text exceeds the maximum length or if the character count is incorrect. The method should return True if validation passes.
